method: Phone viewport 390x844, touch emulation, one fresh context per arm. Open Walk, start, wait for the first published status. A preceding native gesture (look flick 40 px with no waits; slow look drag 40 px over 10 steps of 30 ms; stick flick 40 px) is followed after a declared gap by a CDP touchStart+touchEnd on the Controls button. Click delivery and the help card opening are recorded with every window-capture event. Diagnostic only.
